title: FlowDoc Design Workspace Usability

riskSummary: The 2026-09-03 Design workspace evidence was path-drifted into old FlowDocEditor and is superseded for canonical vNext purposes by evidence-flowdoc-editor-vnext-recovery-path-drift-2026-09-05. These lanes are bounded Editor UI affordances only and this record does not promote frontend readiness, WYSIWYG readiness, Preview readiness, Publish readiness, Backend readiness, Core readiness, production readiness, compatibility readiness, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor full gate now passes after local Core dependency files were restored from Core HEAD for dependency resolution, but Core still has unrelated tracked and untracked changes plus a long-path .git.broken-backup directory. Two recovered Editor WORK checkout directories also remain on disk after git removed them from the worktree registry because deletion was blocked by local policy or permission.
